content: Samwẹl obyengi Devid ana k'eho

Wa ewu dani Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Samwẹl bi, “Óbhir otzuma yan yina akwọbha nkwu-osisi sa Saul owowobha, da kaam nkk'ẹ mmuma mach'ọvaarnọng kw'Israẹl? Tzọkha ana p'ẹbọhk-nana akhe k'erukhimaanha chọ, abikhi orenga, kaam ndọhm-ọ ka Jẹsẹ kw'ofon Bẹtẹlẹhẹm. Kaam nkk'nnwa wani kwẹ kw'ijinọng ndekha bi, ode ọvaarnọng.”

Yina, Samwẹl oben bi, “Kaam ńnenga yan nda o? Idikha Saul ọ́bhaang kwẹ, ófhu-m ofhu e.” Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben bi, “Tzima ọbhaamnwa kwakwẹ atzima afona, apyiri ben-ẹ bi, ‘Nkk'nkwa bi nkwu mfọhni ẹja nnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi e.’
Kọ bher Jẹsẹ okwu m'ẹjafọhni nduma, kaam ńdibh-ọ otzibh ọttọhk f'asi. Kọ ábyengi nwuma kwa ńgọhkh-ọ ana k'eho anang-m.”
Samwẹl osi mach'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obeni. Mada opyiri ka Bẹtẹlẹhẹm, adenho p'obhon ojora bẹ mada bẹ arẹ-ẹ. Bẹ abọbh-ẹ bi, “Akwu k'odidir o?”

Samwẹl obhina bi, “Oo o, k'odidiri wọ kwa kaam nkwu bi nkwu mfọhni ẹja nnang Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi. Mẹ wọ, bọng do for sabọng, akwu mọtza ọfọhni ẹja.” Mẹ wọ, osi Jẹsẹ ọmaana va pẹ p'ijinọng awur, obher bẹ ẹjafọhni.
Mada bẹ apyiri kẹ, Samwẹl ore Eliyab ochibhi bi, “K'odik ọkkakka, ọnọng kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi okk'otzekha bi, bẹ ábyengi ana k'eho obe m'itzitzikha s'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi e.”

Yina, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Samwẹl bi, “Kẹ k'eden ch'ode ọmaana ebe chẹ kàkkeri, okhuri bi kaam nkk'ẹ mmumma. Eden ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi om-ore idik ede ngọmi ttara eden ch'ọnọngẹya ore. Da ọnọngẹya om-ore odik k'iyaan-iyaan, yina, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi om-okkeri ettem.”
Mẹ wọ, Jẹsẹ oyeri Abinadab, otzim-ẹ ọkwọbha Samwẹl k'itzitzikha. Yina, Samwẹl oben bi, “Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oyok nwa kobiro otzekha.”
Jẹsẹ on-obiro otzima Shama okwu, yina, Samwẹl obiro oben bi, “Kẹ rang kw'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obiro otzekha.”
Wa Jẹsẹ otzim va pẹ p'ijinọng azenamfa ọkhọkha Samwẹl, yina, Samwẹl oben-ẹ bi, “Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ọnọng ma kotzek e.”

Mẹ wọ, ọbọbh Jẹsẹ bi, “Va pọ p'ijinọng p'akhaam biphyir bọ ma o?” Jẹsẹ obhin-ẹ bi, “Oyok kw'ikhakhari owobh kẹ e, yina, kẹ om-okkeri arukhimaan e.” Mẹ wọ, Samwẹl oben Jẹsẹ bi, “Tzọhm ọnọng otza oyer-ẹ, m'ẹwọr kówobha maa opyiri.”
Jẹsẹ ọtzọhm anọng atza ayeri Devid okwu. Wa Devid ojibhi ka for, obiro ojibhi odikkobh, obiro ojibh ikkekkeri. Mẹ wọ, Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi oben Samwẹl bi, “Kẹ wọ mẹ e, bina abyeng-ẹ ana k'eho.”

Mẹ wọ, Samwẹl ọtzọkha ana p'otzim k'erukhimaanha obyeng-ẹ k'eho m'itzitzikha s'agbaanotte pẹ. Ttẹwọr m'ewu nduma, Egwugwuma ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ẹhakha ttara ẹfa ẹnwa Devid. Mẹ wọ, Samwẹl obina ọbhana ka Rama.
Devid owobh k'irekh-irek kwa Saul
Wa Egwugwuma ch'Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi ekk'Saul ọbọhk ẹtta. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obiro ọtzọhm egwugwuma-tzama ẹyakh-ẹ atzim.
Atzọhmnọng pa kẹ Saul aben-ẹ bi, “Kker e, egwugwuma-tzama ch'Ibinọkpaabyi ọtzọhmi dọ ẹm-ẹyakh-ọ aztim ma e.
Tte itta kwaman ọtzọhm maman atzọhmnọng pẹ ma, mọtza oror ọnọng kw'ofha okhir ọgangaang. Mada egwugwuma-tzama nduma ẹ́nwọ-ọ, kẹ ókhir ọ́nang-ọ, for igaang-ọ.
Mẹ wọ, Saul oben atzọhmnọng pẹ bi, “Bọng nor ọnọng kw'okpo ọgangaang okhikhir, achen-m.”

Ọtzọhmnọng wani on-obhina bi, “Kaam nkk'nnwa kw'ijinọng kwa Jẹsẹ kw'ofon Bẹtẹlẹhẹm kw'okpo ọgangaang okhikhir nna e. Kẹ ode ọkkakkaama, ọmaana okkenggitza, ọkhaama ekkoji ch'etzim-gbaakha, obiro ojibh odikkobh. Ọvaar Ibinọkpaabyi obir owobha ttar-ẹ.”
Mẹ wọ, Saul ọtzọhm akkaabh-nkkaabha ochena Jẹsẹ, oben bi, “Tzọhm nnwa kwọ Devid, kw'om-okkeri arukhimaan achen-m.”
Mẹ wọ, Jẹsẹ ọtzọkha ẹnyanyaang ch'ọnan brẹd, ọmaana otzuk-gbere, ọmaana ovu-nwa ttara ka nnwa kwẹ Devid ọtzọhm ochena Saul.
Devid okwu owobha k'irekh-irek kwa Saul. Ọdaak Saul idik m'ejibh-ejibha maa, Devid on-okwu ode otzim-egbongkpo kwẹ.
Mẹ wọ, Saul ọtzọhm ẹkkaabha ọnang Jẹsẹ oben bi, “Tte Devid ọbọhk owobha ma osi ọtzọhm faam, okhuri bi, osi ettem ẹdaam-m.”
Ogbe kpenamkpen kw'egwugwuma ch'efon k'Ibinọkpaabyi ẹnwa Saul, Devid ọm-ọtzọkha ọgangaang okhir. Yina for in-igaangi Saul, ọgbagbatzama nwa obiro ọttẹ-ẹ ọbọhk.
